newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sees 109 bln reais tax income in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sees 109 bln reais tax income in 1997.

text.p: The Brazilian government is aiming for 1997 federal tax revenue of between 108-109 billion reais against 95 billion last year, Everardo Maciel, head of the Internal Revenue Service, told a newspaper.
Maciel told the Correio Braziliense daily in an interview that the preliminary projections were based on inflation of 6.33 percent and gross domestic product growth of 4.3 percent.
"We haven't got definite values yet. But revenue should be between 108-109 billion reais," he said.
In 1996, the Brazilian federal government collected a record 95.096 billion reais in tax compared with 84 billion reais in 1995.
